_comment: Sample headless SERVER run configuration. Use this when the simulator should bind locally and replay data. By default, data is sent immediately without waiting for clients to connect. Set waitForClient=true if you need to wait for downstream consumers first.
_usage: Copy this file, adjust the values, then launch with config=/absolute/path/to/your-launch-config.json. CLI values override config-file values.

connection._comment: Server mode binds to a local address/port. Set waitForClient=true to wait for clients before advancing through the file.
connection._socketPayload_comment: These Simulator-only settings convert logical CSV source records for TCP or UDP. Formats default to delimited; header flags default to false so the first record remains an event; X/Y fields are optional but must be set together; WKID defaults to 4326.
connection._xmpp_comment: The xmpp* keys below are only used when protocol=xmpp. The built-in server binds a loopback address unless xmppAllowRemote=true, and creates the automatic velocity-simulator@<domain> identity plus the single external account named here.
connection._xmppExternalPassword_comment: Add xmppExternalPassword (and xmppRoomPassword for a protected room) by hand when you need them. They are read from this file but are never written back by Save Launch Configuration. An empty string is accepted for a local test with no shared secret.

headless._comment: Headless mode runs without creating the normal Electron UI.

output._comment: Optional files that help schedulers, CI jobs, or scripts track the run outcome.

streaming._comment: Replay one line per second, stop at the end of the configured range, and exit when done.
